What this prototype represents

The Oxford chamber reproduces the documented two-hand hoist gesture and center-of-platen placement for inert teaching coupons. The demonstration travel, chamber internals and placement tolerances are schematic. No real controller, chemistry, film growth, or tool qualification is modeled. The separate teaching fixture calculates capacitance for already fabricated dielectrics, not a reading from Oxford hardware.

Ideal parallel-plate model: C = ε₀ εᵣ A / t; if a map is supplied, sum the area-weighted tile capacitors in parallel. Fringing, loss, lead parasitics and actual calibration are omitted. Thickness is in nm; the active area is in mm². Exports preserve coupon IDs and revisions.
